publisher: Oregon Department of Early Learning and Care Child Care Licensing Division

official_sources.evidence: DELC describes a daily-updated portal publishing license status, type, capacity, inspection, enforcement, injury, death, and quality-participation information.
DELC links Find Child Care Oregon as the current family-facing provider and safety portal; no supported bulk/API contract was established.
DELC identifies Certified Center, Certified Family, and Registered Family facility cohorts and provides quarterly aggregate licensing dashboards.
The Child Care Licensing Division regulates licensed child-care facilities and maintains facility-type boundaries.

scope.warning: Portal presence, license type, license status, capacity, inspection, enforcement, quality participation, ERDC eligibility, license exemption, and current operation are separate assertions.

temporal.limitation: Daily portal updates do not provide a supported entity-level bulk/API or captured snapshot date; quarterly dashboard aggregates cannot substitute for provider rows.

next_action: Seek a DELC-sanctioned center-focused entity extract; do not automate the public portal or substitute aggregate dashboard counts, and validate cohort, status, privacy, temporal meaning, reuse, and conservation before admission.
